device.description: Keep the neighbors of this device (exact name).

vrf.description: Keep this VRF's neighbors; required for advertised in a non-default VRF.

peer.description: Keep the neighbor with this peer address.

peer_as.description: Keep neighbors with this remote AS number.

unmodelled_only.description: Keep only neighbors whose peer is not a collected device.

state.description: Keep neighbors in this session state, for example ESTABLISHED.

skip_adj_rib_out.description: Skip the Adj-RIB-Out counts (faster on a large network).

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot to read (default: the newest processed one).

advertised.description: list the prefixes device advertises to peer (needs device and peer; vrf for a non-default VRF) as a paged list instead of neighbor rows; outside: CIDR blocks, keep only prefixes not inside any of them; direction: out (default) or in, where in lists what the device RECEIVED from the peer (Adj-RIB-In after input policy: every prefix with next hop, local preference and AS path), for choosing a prefix to withdraw

routing.description: Forward's routing app as a read (a different question from advertised; give one): where a BGP prefix comes from, who accepts or rejects it, how it propagated and why. view search (default): origin and devices by outcome; trace: propagation paths to routing.router (origin and outcome are taken from a search when absent); details: attributes and policies at one hop of a trace (path, hop); device: what routing.device received and installed for the prefix, per VRF; installed: prefixes installed on routing.device or routing.vendors. A preview route; needs the network ADMIN role (BGP_PREFIX_SEARCH).

prefix.description: CIDR, required except for view installed

vendors.description: lowercase vendor-OS names such as cisco_ios
